description:
Cast Soul Collector by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Soul Collector enters the battlefield, Warstorm Surge and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve Blasting Station's trigger, untapping it.
Resolve Warstorm Surge's trigger, causing Soul Collector to deal damage to itself equal to its power.
If an activated ability from Blasting Station is waiting to resolve, let it resolve.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Soul Collector.
When Soul Collector dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
